notes: The ASV's note that the Hebrew of this verse is obscure was read and set aside; the printed text is what is aligned (rule 38).

The suffix segmented off `ʿăḏînô` is marked `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no possessive anywhere in the name — rule 57's reasoning for a suffix lexicalized in a name, rather than rules 22 and 40 as the unit note cites. The competing reading fuses it into the name's unit under rule 30, on the model of rule 29's `hassōp̄ereṯ` → *Hassophereth*, since the transliteration spells the suffix out.
`rōʾš haššālišî` writes one *the*, standing before the rectum's own word, so the article takes it and the construct is left bare (rule 29).
